spec.title: Redis 8.x
spec.description: Redis 8.10 overview built on the Redis Data Source. Covers every INFO section the server reports, including the keysizes, threads, errorstats, latencystats, modules and search_* sections added since Redis 6.2.

spec.name: redis
spec.label: Redis node
spec.description: One entry per provisioned Redis Data Source, so a cluster is browsed node by node.

spec.title: Version
spec.description: redis_version and the build mode reported by INFO server.

spec.title: Mode
spec.description: standalone, sentinel or cluster.

spec.title: Keys
spec.description: Sum of the keys column of INFO keyspace, across every database.

spec.title: Commands per second
spec.description: instantaneous_ops_per_sec, sampled by the plugin while the dashboard is open.

spec.title: Memory consumers
spec.description: mem_cluster_links arrived in Redis 7.0.

spec.title: Evictions
spec.description: evicted_clients and evicted_scripts were added in Redis 7.0 and 7.4.

spec.title: Key size distribution
spec.description: INFO keysizes, added in Redis 8.0. Every row is a power of two bucket, so 4 covers keys of size 4 to 7. The plugin returns one row per bucket.

spec.title: Clients
spec.description: pubsub_clients and watching_clients arrived in Redis 7.4, active_clients in 8.0.

spec.title: Watched and blocking keys
spec.description: total_blocking_keys and total_blocking_keys_on_nokey arrived in Redis 7.2.

spec.title: Connections and disconnections
spec.description: The buffer limit disconnection counters arrived in Redis 7.0.

spec.title: I/O threads
spec.description: INFO threads, added in Redis 8.0. One row per I/O thread, with the clients it owns and the reads and writes it has processed.

spec.title: Threaded I/O
spec.description: The prefetch counters arrived with the Redis 8.0 threaded engine.

spec.title: Event loop
spec.description: The eventloop and pipeline counters arrived in Redis 7.0.

spec.title: Access denied
spec.description: acl_access_denied_* was added in Redis 7.0 and is the fastest way to spot a client authenticating with the wrong ACL user.

spec.title: Client connections
spec.description: CLIENT LIST. Columns follow the server, so newer fields appear on their own.

spec.title: CPU
spec.description: INFO cpu. The counters are cumulative process time, so the lines only rise: read the slope, or the Delta legend value, as CPU seconds burnt over the window. The main thread counters arrived in Redis 7.0.

spec.title: Copy on write
spec.description: The current_cow_* and current_save_* counters arrived in Redis 7.0.

spec.title: Loading and fsync
spec.description: async_loading arrived in Redis 7.0.

spec.title: Command statistics
spec.description: INFO commandstats. rejected_calls and failed_calls arrived in Redis 6.2 and separate a command the server refused from one that ran and returned an error.

spec.title: Latency percentiles
spec.description: INFO latencystats, added in Redis 7.0. The percentile columns follow the latency-tracking-info-percentiles config, so a server tuned to report other percentiles renders its own columns here.

spec.title: Error statistics
spec.description: INFO errorstats, added in Redis 6.2. One row per error prefix, so a burst of NOPERM or WRONGPASS is visible without reading the log.

spec.title: Expiration
spec.description: expired_subkeys counts hash fields expired by the field level TTLs added in Redis 7.4, which expired_keys does not cover.

spec.title: Slow command counters
spec.description: slowlog_commands_* was added in Redis 8.0 and needs no SLOWLOG GET call.

spec.title: Slow queries log
spec.description: SLOWLOG GET. Arg Count and Truncated come from the seventh entry element added in Redis 8.10: Redis keeps at most 32 arguments, so Command shows what was stored while Arg Count reports what the client actually sent.

spec.title: Replication status
spec.description: master_failover_state arrived in Redis 6.2 with FAILOVER.

spec.title: Replication offset
spec.description: slave0_offset and slave0_lag are expanded from the slave0 record line, which the plugin used to return as one opaque string.

spec.title: Replication traffic
spec.description: total_net_repl_* was split out of total_net_* in Redis 7.0.

spec.title: Keyspace
spec.description: INFO keyspace. subexpiry counts hash fields carrying their own TTL and was added in Redis 7.4.

spec.title: Key size buckets
spec.description: INFO keysizes, added in Redis 8.0. Bucket is the power of two lower bound and Range spells it out, so bucket 4 counts keys of size 4 to 7.

spec.title: Pub/Sub
spec.description: pubsubshard_channels arrived with sharded Pub/Sub in Redis 7.0.

spec.title: Hash field expiration
spec.description: hash_templates and hash_template_keys report the shared hash field TTL templates introduced in Redis 8.x.

spec.title: Modules
spec.description: INFO modules. Redis 8 ships search, ReJSON, timeseries, bf and vectorset in the server, so this row is populated on a stock 8.x install.

spec.title: Search memory
spec.description: Emitted only once at least one index exists, see the note on the right.

spec.title: Search queries
spec.description: Emitted only once at least one index exists, see the note above.

spec.title: Search errors and warnings
spec.description: Emitted only once at least one index exists, see the note above.

options.content:
`INFO SEARCH` only reports the version and the index counters while the server holds **no index**: `search_info_on_zero_indexes` is `OFF` by default, and the memory, query, cursor, garbage collector and dialect sub sections appear as soon as the first index is created.

```
CONFIG SET search-info-on-zero-indexes yes
```

turns them on for an empty server. Field names also move between RediSearch builds, so panels here render *No data* rather than breaking when a name is absent.

spec.title: Nodes
spec.description: CLUSTER NODES. Slots counts the slots served by the node, and a node serving several ranges is counted across all of them.

spec.title: Cluster links
spec.description: mem_cluster_links, added in Redis 7.0, is the memory the cluster bus buffers hold; a link that stops draining shows up here first.

spec.title: Slot migration
spec.description: The cluster_slot_migration_* counters are Redis 8.x, atomic slot migration.

spec.title: Hot keys
spec.description: HOTKEYS GET, added in Redis 8.6. Empty until HOTKEYS START runs, and the command is @admin @dangerous so a read only dashboard user gets NOPERM.

options.content:
`HOTKEYS GET` reports the keys collected since tracking was started. Tracking is not on by default and the dashboard never starts it, because `HOTKEYS START` and `HOTKEYS STOP` change server state and a dashboard refresh must not.

Start it from a shell:

```
redis-cli HOTKEYS START
```

The command family is `@admin @dangerous`, so a dashboard user needs it granted explicitly, otherwise the panel shows *NOPERM*:

```
ACL SETUSER grafana +hotkeys|get
```
